summary: [Google Calendar] objects: Google Calendar API: Calendars, CalendarList (per-user metadata: accessRole, colors), Events (id, iCalUID, summary, description, location, start/end, timeZone, RRULE recurrence, attendees, reminders, conferenceData, status confirmed/tentative/cancelled). Event identity: id (per-calendar) + iCalUID (global). Recurring instances via recurringEventId + originalStartTime.
